verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents alerting over all four requested channels: voice call, SMS, email and push, plus Slack and Teams. Phone-call paging is corroborated in the docs ('press 1 to acknowledge'). However, nothing in the evidence shows a user choosing their own channels or setting per-channel notification rules; escalation policies define who is alerted and in what order, not how each channel is used. missing for 10: per-user per-channel notification rules (channel choice, delays, ordering per channel), independent/hands-on corroboration of multi-channel delivery.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules

citations.quote: Unlimited voice call alerts As well as SMS, e-mail, Slack, Teams, and push notifications with our all-you-can-alert pricing.
When Better Stack calls you, you are prompted to press 1 to acknowledge the incident.
Acknowledge them with a single tap and keep your phone from ringing while fixing the issue.
